Online.desc.join: Join a room using a room code
Online.desc.find: Opens a list of all available public rooms
Online.desc.options: SeiunEngine Online options, configure stuff here!
Online.desc.discord: Join the SeiunEngine Online Discord Server!
Online.desc.docs: Documentation, FAQ and the Source Code!
Online.desc.bluesky: Follow the official SeiunEngine Online Bluesky account!
Online.desc.twitter: Follow the official SeiunEngine Online Twitter account!
Online.presence.notLoggedIn:
Not logged in!

Check OPTIONS to login!
Online.chat.hint: (Type something to input the message, ACCEPT to send)
Online.settings.publicRoom.desc: If enabled, this room will be publicly listed in the FIND tab.
Online.settings.networkOnly.desc: If enabled, only registered players to the network can join.
Online.settings.anarchy.desc: This option gives other players host permissions.
Online.settings.playersChoose.desc: This option gives other players permission to pick a song and stage.
Online.settings.teamMode.desc: Compete in Teams rather than individually! Your performance will be averaged with your teammate.
Online.settings.oneLane.desc: Everybody plays on the same side!
Online.settings.oneLaneOpp.desc: Everybody plays on opponent side when enabled.
Online.settings.win.accuracy: Side with the highest Accuracy wins!
Online.settings.win.score: Side with the highest Score wins!
Online.settings.win.misses: Side with the least Misses wins!
Online.settings.win.fp: Side with the most FP wins!
Online.settings.win.combo: Side with the highest Combo wins!
Online.settings.pause.hostOnly: Only the host can pause; everyone else is paused too.
Online.settings.pause.everyone: When anyone pauses, everyone is paused.
Online.settings.pause.legacy: Pauses stay local to each player (old behaviour, desyncs).
Online.pause.title: Paused
Online.pause.hostOnly: Only the host can pause the game!
Online.pause.waitResume: Wait for the player who paused the game to resume!
Online.pause.resumeHostOnly: Only the host can resume the game!
Online.room.noStage: You don't have the current stage!
Online.room.noSongMod: You don't have the current song/mod!
Online.room.hostOnly: Only the host can do that!
Online.room.songInstalled: You already have this song installed!
Online.room.modNoURL: Host didn't specify the URL of this mod
Online.room.modExpectedPath: Expected mod data to exist in this path:
Online.room.chartSegmented.desc: Online play only supports one-file charts (data/<song>/<song>.json). This chart is split into several part files, so its hash cannot be verified and the room cannot start. Use its single-file chart.
Online.room.tip.ready:
- START GAME/READY - 
Toggles your READY status.

Players also need to have the
currently selected mod installed.

(Both sides can only
have up to 2 players).
Online.room.tip.code:
- ROOM CODE - 
Unique code of this room.

ACCEPT - Reveals the code and
copies it to your clipboard.

CTRL + C - Copies the code without
revealing it on the screen.
Online.room.tip.song:
- SELECT SONG - 
Selects the song.

(Players with host permissions
can only do that)
Online.room.tip.mod:
- MOD - 
Downloads the currently selected mod
if it isn't installed.

After you install it
press this button again!

RIGHT CLICK - Open Mod Downloader
Online.room.tip.lobby:
- LOBBY - 
Press UI keybinds
or use your mouse
to select an option!
Online.verifyCode.title:
A Verification Code may have been sent to this email!
Please note, that the server will not tell you if this email is registered!
If you can't find it, check your spam inbox.
Enter it here, if you receive it!
Online.options.setupMods.desc: Set the URL's of your mods here!
Online.options.server.desc: The server that hosts game rooms.
Online.options.networkServer.desc: Chat, friends and leaderboards use this address.
Online.options.clearTrusted.desc: Clear the list of all trusted domains!
Online.options.sslVerify.desc:
If checked, the game will check for valid SSL Certifications, which can lead to safer connections with downloads or rooms.
(But It's not recommended because of Haxe's flawed sockets implementation.)
Online.options.register.desc:
Join the SeiunEngine Online Network and submit your song replays
to the leaderboards!
Online.options.registered.desc:
New features have appeared in the sidebar!
Press
Online.options.login.desc: Input your email address here and wait for your One-Time Login Code!
Online.options.chatNotify.desc:
If checked, all messages from the Network Chat will be notified to you.
Can be toggled with "/notify" Network command.
Online.options.mutePM.desc:
If checked, PM notifications are muted.
Can be toggled with "/notify pm" Network command.
Online.options.muteInvites.desc:
If checked, room invites are muted.
Can be toggled with "/notify roominvite" Network command.
Online.options.friendOnline.desc:
If checked, you'll receive a notification when your friend goes online.
Can be toggled with "/notify friend" Network command.
Online.options.globalMessage.desc:
Leave a message for others to see in the Online Menu!
(Please keep it English)
Online.options.loginBrowser.desc: Authenticates you to the network in your default web browser
Online.options.deleteConfirm:
Are you sure you want to delete your account?
(This action is irreversible!)
Online.options.logout.desc: Logout of the SeiunEngine Online Network
Online.options.logoutConfirm: Are you sure you want to logout?
Online.setupMods.title:
Before you play, it is recommended to set links for your mods!
Select mods with ACCEPT, Paste links with CTRL + V, Leave with BACK
Hold SHIFT while exiting to discard all changes
Online.stage.default.desc: Default option uses the stage of the currently selected song
Online.dl.search: Search mods here // Enter a URL to download...
Online.skins.move: Use Note keybinds while pressing SHIFT to move!
Online.skins.tip1:
TAB - Flip skin
8 - Edit skin
CTRL - Open the Character List
Online.skins.tip2:
- Favorite skin
F2 to Browse GB Skins Category
F1 for Help!
Online.mods.fileKept: The downloaded file was kept at:
Online.mods.fileNotKept: The downloaded file could not be kept.
Online.mods.rarUnsupported: RAR is not supported on this platform!
Online.mods.corrupted: Mod's data is corrupted or invalid!
Online.mods.noDataInArchive: Mod data not found inside of the archive!
Online.mods.installError.desc:
It seems this mod directory is already being accessed
by the game or another program!

Please try again by re-opening the game!
Online.mods.unsupportedArchive:
Unsupported file archive type!
(Only ZIP, TAR, TGZ, RAR archives are supported!)
Online.dl.tooMany: Too many files are downloading right now! (Max 6)
Online.dl.badFileType: may be invalid or unsupported file type!
Online.request.openLink: Do you want to open this link
Online.request.download: Do you want to download this file
Online.request.trust.desc:
If checked, you will no longer be asked
to accept links from this domain.
Online.net.sessionExpired.desc: Log in again with a new code.
Online.net.notSeiunServer: This is not a SeiunEngine server
Online.net.notSeiunServer.desc: The server did not answer the SeiunEngine handshake. Nothing was joined.
Online.net.psychOnlineServer.desc: This engine no longer speaks the PsychOnline protocol. Pick a SeiunEngine server in the server list.
Online.net.engineMismatch: This server runs a different SeiunEngine version
Online.net.engineMismatch.desc: Update the game (or the server) and try again.
Online.net.noStateData: Client couldn't receive server's state data!
Online.net.invited: has invited you to their room!
Online.url.mediafireLink: Couldn't fetch the download link for this MediaFire file!
Online.net.connectFailedExcl: Failed to connect to the Network!
Online.options.scoreDetails.desc:
If checked, online score texts show every value on its own line.
Unchecked keeps them on one compact line.
Online.options.serverAdd.desc: Creates a new entry with the default address and selects it.
Online.options.serverDelete.desc: Removes the selected server from the list.
Online.options.serverDeleteConfirm: Remove this server from the list?
Online.options.serverName.desc: Shown in the list above. Leave empty to show the address.
Online.options.placeholder.name: Name
Online.options.servers.desc: Pick, add or edit the servers you connect to.
Online.options.serverMoveUp.desc: Moves the selected server one slot up.
Online.options.serverMoveDown.desc: Moves the selected server one slot down.
Online.options.serverList.tip: Click a row to switch servers; edit a field and click the button next to it, or press ENTER.
Online.options.serverLan.desc: Fills the selected entry with this PC's LAN address (the host PC must run the server with -Lan).
Online.options.serverLanNone: No LAN address was detected; read the host PC's IPv4 from ipconfig and type it into the Server Address field.
Online.options.serverLanNoneAlert.desc: On this platform the address cannot be listed automatically. Run ipconfig on the host PC and type its IPv4 address into the Server Address field, for example 192.168.1.50.
Online.options.credState.desc: Credentials are stored per server in seiun_auth.json.
Online.options.remember.desc: Keeps this server's credential on disk so it survives a restart.
Online.options.autoLogin.desc: Refreshes the saved credential on launch instead of asking for a code again.
Online.options.autoLoginOff: Automatic login turned off; the next launch will ask you to log in again.
Online.options.credLifetime.desc: How long this server's credential stays valid; 0 asks the server for its default. A server can pin its own value.
Online.options.credClear.desc: Deletes the credential stored on disk for the selected server.
Online.options.credClearConfirm: Delete the saved credential for this server?
Online.desc.friends: Your friends, friend requests and the users you added.
Online.desc.notifications: Messages and friend activity sent to your account.
Online.friends.title: FRIENDS
Online.friends.empty: No friends yet. Press R to add one!
Online.friends.tip: ENTER / X: remove friend - R: add friend - TAB: switch tab
Online.friends.tip.received: ENTER: accept request - R: add friend - TAB: switch tab
Online.notifications.tip: ENTER: open link - X: delete - TAB: switch tab
Online.user.tip: LEFT/RIGHT: button - ENTER: use - BACK: return
Online.user.edit.tip: UP/DOWN: field - LEFT/RIGHT: adjust - ENTER: type or save - ESC: cancel
Online.user.resetSecret.ok: The credential was rotated on the server.
Online.search.title: SEARCH
Online.search.tip: Type to search - LEFT/RIGHT: users or songs - ENTER: open or search - BACK: return
Online.desc.stats: How many players were online over the last days.
Online.stats.title: PLAYER HISTORY
Online.desc.lanhost: Host the server on this PC and let LAN friends join with a room code
Online.lan.start.desc: Starts the server on this PC and joins its room, so friends on your network can play.
Online.lan.stop.desc: Stops the server on this PC and leaves the local room.
Online.lan.port.desc: Port of the local server. If it is busy the next free pair is used and shown below.
Online.lan.maxPlayers.desc: How many players may be in the room at once (1-64).
Online.lan.allowSamePc.desc: Lets several sessions from one IP join, so you can test with a second client on this PC.
Online.lan.publicRoom.desc: List the room on this server so other LAN players can find it in FIND. Off = room code only.
Online.lan.address.noneRunning: No LAN address was detected. Read this PC IPv4 from the system settings and type it for your friends.
Online.lan.firewall.text: Windows may ask to allow the game on your network: allow it for Private networks, or friends cannot connect.
Online.lan.android.foreground: Keep the game in the foreground while hosting; Android may freeze it in the background and drop the room.
Online.lan.webConsole.desc: Opens the hosted server console in your browser (this PC only).
Online.lan.webConsole.closed.desc: Start hosting first; the console listens on this PC only.
Online.lan.back.desc: Return to the online menu. Hosting keeps running until you stop it.
Online.lan.tip: ENTER: select - UP/DOWN: move - BACK: return
Online.lan.port.invalid.desc: Use a port between 1024 and 65534, for example 2567.
Online.lan.pref.restart.desc: Stop hosting and start again to use the new port.
Online.lan.error.title: LAN hosting failed
Online.lan.error.portBusy: No free port was found near
Online.lan.error.start: The LAN server could not start:
Online.lan.error.timeout: The LAN server did not answer /api/health in time.
Online.lan.error.dataDir: Could not create the LAN host data folder:
Online.lan.error.join: The room could not be created:
Online.lan.error.alreadyStarted: The embedded server is still in use by this game session (or was started with another data folder). Restart the game to host again.
